rationale: AEIS could not claim production readiness while production deploy was only a rehearsal/probe surface. This change adds a production deploy pipeline contract with explicit build, container scan, staging deploy, smoke, canary, production deploy, post-deploy verification and rollback drill stages. It is D4 because it changes public deployment API behavior and introduces a production Human Gate controlled operational path.

steps: Revert deployment_gate project_id/run_id ticket matching if it causes compatibility issues.
Run deployment, deploy route, rollback manager and production deploy route tests twice.

fidelity_test.description: Verify that a production deploy requires Human Gate approval, records every pipeline stage with evidence, blocks on scan/canary failures, runs a rollback drill and can restore the previous artifact on an operator-approved rollback.
pre_conditions: EvidenceSpine can register inline JSON artifacts.
Governance ticket store can create and resolve D4 production tickets.
steps: Run compileall for the production deploy service, API route, router and deployment gate.
Run unit tests for ProductionDeployPipeline success, approval guard, canary failure, post-deploy rollback and container scan failure.
Run API tests proving production deploy and actual rollback require Human Gate approval.
Run existing deployment orchestrator, deploy routes and rollback manager regression tests.
Run no-mock scan and git diff whitespace check.
Repeat the same verification scope as PASS2.
fidelity_test.expected_outcome: The pipeline reaches completed only after all stages pass, records rollback drill evidence, blocks false production progression on failures and restores the previous artifact when rollback is approved.
